bio.zh: 我在 Unilever Horizon3 AI Labs 做生产级 Generative AI 与多智能体系统，覆盖编排、检索、工具调用、评估与部署。这里是我的面试准备手册：用 Markdown 记录笔记、投递与复习进度。
bio.en: I build production-grade Generative AI and agentic systems at Unilever Horizon3 AI Labs — orchestration, retrieval, tool calling, evaluation, and deployment. This site is my interview prep handbook: notes, applications, and review progress in Markdown.
